cases.name: Missing foundation
cases.prompt: I have a vacancy description and some job-history notes. I need a resume and cover letter but have no resume yet.
expectations: Starts with Resume Builder for the base document.
Names Resume Customizer for targeting once the base exists.
Names Letter Composer for the requested letter.
Handoff preserves the posting and notes without fabricating experience.

cases.name: Clarify a vague request
cases.prompt: Can you help with my LinkedIn? I might mean rewriting my headline or keeping track of the jobs I saved.
expectations: Distinguishes public profile text from opportunity tracking.
Names bLinkIn Tuner and Career Seeker with their purposes.
Asks which deliverable the person wants first.
Does not imply access to the person's saved jobs or profile.

cases.name: Fit before application
cases.prompt: I am choosing between analyst and operations roles. I have not selected any posting.
expectations: Explains that role selection comes before tailoring to a vacancy.
Copies both target roles into the brief.
Requests experience or constraints instead of producing a targeted resume.
